note: Sri Sathya Sai district (headquarters Puttaparthi), Rayalaseema: carved out of Anantapur district in April 2022, in the same scarce rainfall zone (NARP AP-6). No contingency plan has been published for the new district, so it takes the normal sowing periods of the undivided Ananthapuramu plan, which covered this land; nothing else is changed.
